questions.question: Against whose drunkards is the woe in Isaiah 28?
What precious stone does the LORD lay in Zion in Isaiah 28?
options: A pillar of fire to lead the way
A high tower overlooking the city
A great wall of bronze around the temple
A tested cornerstone, a sure foundation
questions.answer: A tested cornerstone, a sure foundation

questions.question: Isaiah 28 says, 'Whoever believes will not be in haste.'
Behold, I am the one who has laid as a foundation in Zion, a stone, a tested stone, a precious _____, a sure foundation.
For it is precept upon precept, line upon _____, here a little, there a little.
